items.title: GoDaddy (GDDY) Rolls Out Airo AI Builder For Entrepreneurs Running Online Stores
items.summary: GoDaddy (NYSE:GDDY) launched its new Airo AI Builder platform, aimed at helping entrepreneurs create and run online stores through a conversational interface. The Airo AI Builder combines website creation, product catalog setup, payment processing, and order tracking in a single commerce workflow. GoDaddy is targeting small businesses and solo entrepreneurs who want to manage online sales without deep technical or coding skills. There is more to GoDaddy than the fresh launch of its Airo AI...
